name: Drive Like Jehu
label: Headhunter
lede: Two albums, one 9-minute song, and a 19-year silence broken by a pipe organ in Balboa Park.

eras.title: Two San Diego bands, one new guitar team
eras.text: Reis and Froberg spent four years in Pitchfork while Kennedy and Trombino played in Night Soil Man. In 1990 both bands ended and the four of them became one.

years.src: Wikipedia: Pitchfork (band) · Wikipedia: Drive Like Jehu
years.h: Rick Froberg and John Reis start Pitchfork in San Diego
years.p: Froberg sings and draws the art, Reis plays guitar. Pitchfork puts out the three-song Saturn Outhouse EP in 1989 and one album, Eucalyptus, on Nemesis in 1990.
years.xp:
The lineup around them was bassist Don Ankrom (later replaced by Nick Frederick) and drummer Joey Piro. Pitchfork ended in 1990, and Swami Records, Reis's own label, later put both releases on one CD in 2003.

Across town, Mike Kennedy and Mark Trombino spent 1987 to 1990 in a band called Night Soil Man. The two pairs were about to be one band.

years.cap: Early Drive Like Jehu, San Diego
years.src: Wikipedia: Drive Like Jehu · Wikipedia: Rocket from the Crypt
years.h: Reis starts Drive Like Jehu, with a drummer named Chris Bratton
years.p: Reis pulls in Froberg and bassist Kennedy. The name comes from the Bible's chariot-driving king Jehu.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, Reis formed the band in August 1990, the same year Pitchfork and Night Soil Man both broke up and the year he also started [[Rocket from the Crypt|e297ecdf-64ec-4e34-899d-80380f5b0c2a]]. Bratton was the first drummer.

He did not last: Wikipedia says it simply "didn't work out," and Trombino took the stool, completing the lineup that made both records.

years.h: Mark Trombino takes the drum stool from Bratton
years.p: Trombino, ex-Night Soil Man, is the drummer on every Drive Like Jehu record.

eras.title: Cargo, Headhunter and a Merge 7-inch
eras.text: Reis puts out two debuts in the same year and Drive Like Jehu's turns out to be the one people keep.

q: All the music is designed for maximum physical gratification.
years.src: Wikipedia: Drive Like Jehu (album) · San Diego Reader: Drive Like Jehu
years.h: Drive Like Jehu: nine songs, 44 minutes, Froberg's own cover art
years.p: Recorded at Westbeach Recorders in Los Angeles with producer Donnell Cameron and released on Cargo and Headhunter.
years.xp:
AllMusic's Ned Raggett wrote that the two guitarists sound like they've been "dipped in battery acid, wired to a power station, and let absolutely loose." Wikipedia counts nine tracks and a running time of 44:56.

Froberg's line on the band, to the San Diego Reader: the music is built for physical payoff.

years.h: Reis puts out two debuts at once: this one and Rocket from the Crypt's
years.p: Rocket from the Crypt's Paint as a Fragrance comes out alongside Drive Like Jehu, both from the same guitarist's desk.

years.h: A 7-inch on Merge: "Hand Over Fist" and "Bullet Train to Vegas"
years.p: Also in 1992, "Sinews" appears on the Head Start to Purgatory compilation from Cargo and Headhunter.

eras.title: Interscope pays for it, then it's over
eras.text: Yank Crime is the record, and touring it in the US and Europe is the last thing the band does before it stops.

years.src: Wikipedia: Yank Crime · Magnet: Lost Classics, Drive Like Jehu Yank Crime · Treble: Drive Like Jehu, Yank Crime
years.h: Yank Crime: the second record, on Interscope
years.p: Recorded at Westbeach Recorders and Big Fish Studios. It opens with "Here Come the Rome Plows" in 5/4.
years.xp:
Interscope had signed both of Reis's bands. Magnet's version: Rocket from the Crypt "erupted" and the label offered "ridiculous amounts of money" to both bands. Treble reports Reis saying Interscope wanted Drive Like Jehu on its own.

Magnet also says Yank Crime and Rocket from the Crypt's three major-label records "proved to be money pits" for the label. Rolling Stone later ranked it number 16 on its list of the 40 greatest emo albums.

years.src: Wikipedia: Rick Froberg · Wikipedia: Yank Crime
years.h: Froberg draws the cover of every record the band makes
years.p: He did both Drive Like Jehu albums, and the sleeves for Rocket from the Crypt and Swami too.
years.xp: Wikipedia's Froberg entry calls him the illustrator and designer across his bands' releases, including artwork for Rocket from the Crypt and Swami Records. In 2025 Akashic Books published a book of his art, Plenty for All.

years.big: I equate building tension with repetition.
years.src: Treble: Drive Like Jehu, Yank Crime · Wikipedia: Yank Crime
years.h: "Luau" runs about nine minutes, with Rob Crow on backing vocals
years.p: Reis, on how the band writes. Pinback's [[Rob Crow|bd55048b-137d-46cf-845d-604a51b5ade1]] sings on the song's back half; Treble calls it the album's centerpiece.
years.xp: Treble adds that Reis also talks about certain notes that "rub against each other", which is the part of the band's method that a fan can hear on the record.

years.src: Wikipedia: Drive Like Jehu · Consequence: The Strange Return of Drive Like Jehu · Wikipedia: Rocket from the Crypt
years.h: Drive Like Jehu just stops, after touring Yank Crime in the US and Europe
years.p: There was no announcement. Reis's other band, Rocket from the Crypt, was on Interscope with Scream, Dracula, Scream! in 1995.
years.xp: Wikipedia says the band "disbanded in 1995 without an official announcement." Consequence writes that the members' "disparate interests" pulled them apart. Rocket from the Crypt's "On a Rope" reached number 12 on the UK Singles Chart that year.

years.h: Froberg moves to New York, Kennedy becomes a chemist, Trombino a producer
years.p: Trombino goes on to record Blink-182 and Jimmy Eat World, per Wikipedia and Consequence. Froberg plays briefly in Thingy before turning to visual art.

eras.title: Everybody scatters, the records don't
eras.text: Reis and Froberg go back to work as Hot Snakes, Trombino goes to the mixing desk, and the records find younger bands.

years.h: Froberg and Reis are back, as [[Hot Snakes|dfa0e21c-ee3e-44da-81d5-58e3c1218a9f]]
years.p: Automatic Midnight comes out on Reis's Swami Records. Hot Snakes go on to three studio albums (2000, 2002, 2004) before breaking up in 2005.

years.src: Wikipedia: Drive Like Jehu · Wikipedia: Yank Crime
years.h: Swami reissues Yank Crime with the 7-inch and "Sinews" added
years.p: The Pitchfork review of the reissue gave it a 9.0.

years.h: Deftones cover "Caress", one of Drive Like Jehu's
years.p: Wikipedia lists Deftones, At the Drive-In, Botch, Modest Mouse and The Dillinger Escape Plan among bands that cite Drive Like Jehu.

years.src: Consequence: The Strange Return of Drive Like Jehu
years.h: Trombino opens a doughnut shop called Donut Friend in Los Angeles
years.p: Consequence reports a second location followed in 2019.

eras.title: The organ show
eras.text: A free San Diego afternoon with a pipe organ turns into two years of festival dates.

years.cap: Spreckels Organ Pavilion, Balboa Park, August 31, 2014
years.src: Wikipedia: Drive Like Jehu · setlist.fm: Drive Like Jehu at Spreckels Organ Pavilion · BrooklynVegan: Drive Like Jehu first show in 19 years
years.h: First show in 19 years: five songs in a park, with a pipe organ
years.p: Drive Like Jehu play San Diego's Spreckels Organ Pavilion with civic organist Dr. Carol Williams. Trombino bought a drum kit for it.
years.xp:
The set was "Do You Compute," "Super Unison," "Sinews," "If It Kills You" and "Luau," with Rob Crow singing on "Luau." Dang Nguyen, who co-owns Bar Pink with Reis and sits on the Spreckels Organ Society board, set it up.

Reis told the press why the organ appealed:

"I especially love the way the low-end sound on the organ is so massive." Trombino had not owned a drum set since the breakup, according to Wikipedia.

years.src: Wikipedia: Drive Like Jehu · mxdwn: Drive Like Jehu reunites for Coachella 2015 · Consequence: The Strange Return of Drive Like Jehu
years.h: The Casbah twice, Pomona, then Coachella two weekends running
years.p: Casbah in San Diego on April 7 and 14, Pomona on the 8th, Coachella on April 11 and 18.
years.xp: Coachella announced the band in January 2015; mxdwn noted the August 2014 show had been expected to be a one-off. Consequence says the festival sets came to three songs in 40 minutes, since the songs run long.

years.h: Iceland, San Francisco, then the last shows of the reunion
years.p: ATP Iceland in Keflavik on July 3, 2015, Treasure Island Music Festival on October 18, and Noise Pop in 2016 before the run wraps in August 2016.

eras.title: Froberg's art
eras.text: Rick Froberg dies in 2023, and his drawings get their own book.

years.src: Wikipedia: Rick Froberg · BrooklynVegan: Rick Froberg dead at 55 · Rolling Stone: Rick Froberg dead at 55 · Clash: Rick Froberg has died
years.h: Rick Froberg dies at 55
years.p: Reis announced it on Instagram: "Rick passed away suddenly last night from natural causes."
years.xp:
Wikipedia and BrooklynVegan give his death as due to an undiagnosed heart condition, which BrooklynVegan attributes to a post by his girlfriend. Rolling Stone reports that shortly before his death he said the fifth Hot Snakes album was nearly finished.

Reis's post continued: "His art made life better. The only thing he loved more than art and rock n roll was his friends."

years.h: Plenty for All: The Art of Rick Fröberg is published by Akashic
years.p: Pen and ink, linocuts, paintings and band art, per Wikipedia.
